title: Moltenite Ore
description: This mod adds a new ore called moltenite which is better than netherite and hard to find.
body:
Moltenite ore is and ore found deep within caves granting power to those who weild it.

This mod adds a new set of tools and armour made with moltenite ingots, magma, and blaze rods.
The moltenite sword has a special ability upon being right clicked granting the user some good buffs to make them stronger and faster while fighting.
